scheme_name: National Handloom Development Programme (NHDP): Scholarship Component
other_conditions: Children of handloom weavers or workers (maximum of two children per family)
Applicants must be enrolled in 3‑ or 4‑year Diploma, Graduate or Post‑Graduate programmes at Central or State Government‑recognized and funded textile institutions
benefits_summary: Provides up to ₹2,00,000 per year for tuition and related fees along with a monthly stipend of ₹5,000 for eligible children of handloom weavers.
documents_required: Copies of all mandatory documents (self‑attested if required)
Original documents verified/attested by the WSC
Proposal submitted by the concerned WSC
Mark sheet for the annual exam
Admission proof for the next academic session
